verdict.rationale: Atlassian publishes the Jira Cloud platform REST API as a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.1 document with 433 paths. It is linked from the REST v3 reference intro and accompanied by a vendor-generated Postman collection. The probe's 404s at generic well-known paths do not contradict this, because the spec lives at a product-specific URL. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the spec's completeness and accuracy, and discoverability at standard well-known paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Atlassian publishes the Jira Cloud platform REST API as a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.1 document (info title "The Jira Cloud platform REST API", 433 paths), linked from the REST v3 reference intro, alongside a vendor-generated Postman collection export.
This documentation is for version 3 of the Jira Cloud platform REST API, which is the latest version.
